name: Scroll
description: Scroll area with custom scrollbars for overflow.

notes: Custom scrollbar implementation for visual consistency

usage.summary: Scroll forwards native div attributes to its outer root. Use viewport-ref for the inner scrolling element. Prop names are kebab-case, not camelCase.

rules.title: Constrain the parent
rules.description:
Vertical Scroll fills parent height. Give the parent a definite height; use min-h-0 on shrinking grid/flex tracks. Example:
{content}
.

rules.title: Reserve the scrollbar gutter
rules.description: Use inline when edge-aligned content must not sit beneath the scrollbar.

contract.element: div wrapping a scrolling viewport; enabled={false} uses the non-scrolling path
contract.nativeProps: Div attributes/events go to the outer root. Use viewport-ref to access scrollTop/scrollLeft on the actual viewport.
contract.state: No controlled React scroll-position prop. Use viewport-ref for programmatic position and storage-key for session restoration.
contract.layout: Vertical Scroll needs a definite parent height and min-h-0 on shrinking flex/grid tracks. max-height/max-width cap the viewport; inline reserves a scrollbar gutter. Prop names are kebab-case.
contract.composition: Use Scroll directly as the constrained layout child; avoid stacking independent scroll owners. Optional Track/Thumb customize the scrollbar.
contract.accessibility: Name the scrolling region when needed using root ARIA attributes. presentational changes structural roles, not keyboard behavior. The native viewport remains the scrolling element.

examples.name: Fixed-height scrolling region
examples.description: Constrain the parent and reserve a scrollbar gutter.
